items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: The first guy that started writing for Goodman was Jimmy Mundy.

ctx.x: Yeah. The first guy that started writing for Goodman was Jimmy Mundy. He got some of their -- Fletcher and some of the Horace Henderson, I bet, finally made Henderson this band just write complete right to play for him. That was his idea. He wanted band like Henderson band, and he succeeded to have a hell of a -- he developed the best white jazz guys band in that era, but nothing (inaudible).

So they got so popular and so big with the Savoy Ballroom arrangement a battle of music - (unintelligible) Chick Webb and Benny Goodman. The biggest event of music has happened in the city of New York, up to moment opened that (unintelligible).
